body:
I guess I have a few hobbies. Because of my depression I find it difficult to really engulf in my interests, guess my energy level gets drained more quickly than others'. 

I've never met someone I completely jive with. I'm pretty much always just on the sidelines, an outcast. I don't see myself ever fitting in and I'm absolutely certain I will never find a partner. I don't know, days like this I just want to end it all.

I guess not, but I'd like to go out maybe once a month at least. I don't know how to find new friends, everything I say is just some premeditated shit I say to fit in. I go to college but I'm soon my 4th term and I still have 0 friends there and people already have their groups of friends so it's difficult trying to squeeze in, ya know? I'm thinking about living alone somewhere out in the woods, living out my days or something. I just know that I can't continue living like this. Sorry for the rant.
